tasks_recurrence_date_uq.name: tasks_recurrence_date_uq
tasks_recurrence_date_uq.where: "tasks"."recurrence_id" is not null and "tasks"."deleted_at" is null

tasks_external_uq.name: tasks_external_uq
tasks_external_uq.where: "tasks"."external_id" is not null and "tasks"."deleted_at" is null

asset_comments_body_ck.name: asset_comments_body_ck
asset_comments_body_ck.value: length("asset_comments"."body") <= 5000 and ("asset_comments"."action" is not null or length("asset_comments"."body") >= 1)

task_recurrences_when_ck.name: task_recurrences_when_ck
task_recurrences_when_ck.value: ("task_recurrences"."frequency" = 'weekly' and "task_recurrences"."weekday" between 1 and 6) or ("task_recurrences"."frequency" = 'monthly' and ("task_recurrences"."day_of_month" between 1 and 28 or "task_recurrences"."day_of_month" = 31))

client_links_source_ck.name: client_links_source_ck
client_links_source_ck.value: ("client_links"."url" is not null) <> ("client_links"."file_id" is not null)

client_results_counts_ck.name: client_results_counts_ck
client_results_counts_ck.value: coalesce("client_results"."leads", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("client_results"."spend_paise", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("client_results"."calls_booked", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("client_results"."admissions", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("client_results"."target_leads", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("client_results"."target_admissions", 0) >= 0

chat_messages_body_ck.name: chat_messages_body_ck
chat_messages_body_ck.value: length("chat_messages"."body") <= 4000 and (length("chat_messages"."body") >= 1 or "chat_messages"."file_id" is not null)

swipe_items_source_ck.name: swipe_items_source_ck
swipe_items_source_ck.value: "swipe_items"."url" is not null or "swipe_items"."file_id" is not null
